name: ctem
description: PNH2 — Clinical Trial Eligibility Matcher. Explainable, deterministic patient-to-protocol screening.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
